snapshot_comparison.warning: Preserve scope in the key; do not merge or sum overlapping combined and NSE reports, and do not label June snapshots current.

symbol_subset.interpretation: Observed 100-row-per-date cap and absolute-net sorting are consistent with a top-100-style subset. The source is not all-stock coverage and scrip labels are company-name strings, not verified NSE instrument identifiers.

historical_cash.date_convention_caution: Date bounds in this report are the dd-mm-yyyy interpretation, not independent upstream date validation. Ambiguous dates require source verification; do not silently swap day and month.
historical_cash.unit_caution: This file does not label currency scale in its headers.

oi_contract_mismatches.interpretation: Contract counts are integers, so exact total checks flag these six mismatches; no correction was applied.

aggregate_quantity_rounding.interpretation: The quantity fields are displayed to one decimal. The generic 0.011 diagnostic threshold is not a rejection rule; a residual of 0.1 fits combined one-decimal rounding tolerance.

rolling_gap_checks.interpretation: These supplied rolling fields span adjacent available rows across multi-year gaps, not consecutive trading sessions. Do not treat the d suffix as a verified session window. Z-scores and streak fields likewise require gap-aware recomputation before strategy use; not recomputed here.

entity_sum_exceptions.interpretation: Do not assume aggregate and entity-level files share complete scope. No cause established or adjustment applied.

limitations: Exploratory read-only audit, not a production ingestion validator or proof of source authority.
Missing markers recognized as blank, (null), null, nan, n/a, na; zero numerical values remain distinct.
Repeated date values in multi-row participant/transaction datasets are expected and are not duplicate-record defects; use candidate compound-key results, not date-only counts.
No type-code meanings, corporate actions, investor identity, company identity, exchange scope or currency conventions independently verified online.
Raw transaction identifiers, masked FII codes and broker identifiers were processed only in memory and are excluded from this evidence.
Candidate key uniqueness is limited to each inspected file and does not prove cross-file deduplication safety.
Historical data is not current September 2026 provider data and has not been compared with Mongo.
No supported binary XLS reader found among bundled xlrd, python_calamine, pyexcel, olefile, polars, xlsx or exceljs; the three binary XLS contents remain unread; no installation or native UI used.
